taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: Drawn as a forb: a mat of woody-based, spreading or prostrate branches (Abrams 1951 p. 412), which the herb program draws as many low, outward-leaning stems.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a mat 5 cm to 10 cm high; Abrams (1951 p. 412) gives the prostrate branches as 1 dm to 3 dm long, drawn as short ascending stems, 7 cm long and leaning out, as the herb program cannot lay a stem down and turn its tip up.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: freely branching from a stout woody base, the branches woody.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: a perennial from a stout woody base.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: leaves along the spreading branches, with no basal rosette.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Opposite, as Phlox's leaves are and the photos show: Abrams (1951 p. 412) does not say for the species.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: leaves 10 mm to 15 mm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: leaves narrowly linear to awl-shaped, only moderately stiff and sharp.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: flowers usually single at the ends of short leafy branches.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Five equal corolla lobes round the tube: a regular flower, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 121108, 118597832, 19156581, 227539949, 227635345, 182159147, 173991364, 129771749): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: a corolla tube 10 mm to 13 mm long with spreading lobes: salver-shaped.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: corolla lobes 6 mm to 7 mm long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: corolla lobes 6 mm to 7 mm long, spreading from a narrow tube, so the limb about twice that across.

traits.petal_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: lobes broadly obovate to obovate-spatulate.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: corolla pink, lilac or sometimes white; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: A capsule, as in the family (Abrams 1951): the species account does not describe its fruit.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 412, Phlox diffusa: flowering May to August.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: woody brown branches densely set with dark green needle-like leaves.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for spreading phlox from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite: the herb program's structure (stems, nodes, basal leaves, how the flowers are borne). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.08 m tall at 3 years in the open, within the flora's range. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
